notes: Buildings of the north-east district, one entry per roof part. Outlines: wall lines fitted to the 2017 LiDAR roof-edge returns (outermost roof return and the nearest ground return beyond it, midway), each building at its own axis angle, corners by intersection; OSM footprints used only as a start. Heights NAVD88 from the LiDAR: flat tops are the roof parapet, pitched parts give ridge (99.5th percentile) and eave (returns just inside the edge). Roof-top parts carry base = the roof they stand on. Facade colours, window sizes and floor counts are guesses unless a source is cited. The base of every part comes from the terrain; ground ranges round each building (2nd-98th percentile of ground returns 1-3 m outside) are listed here. CarParc Diem: ground round the deck 115.8..125.5 m (south-west corner high, north-east low); stair towers SW 122.9..125.8, SE 121.8..122.8, NE 115.4..116.3. Dinallo Heights: ground round the west wing 125.7..129.8 m, east wing 126.4..136.2 m, link 125.9..129.9 m. Student Recreation Center: ground round the west hall 131.0..139.0 m, east hall 130.2..139.0 m, low wing 132.1..139.0 m (north side about 130-131 m, south side about 139 m). Machuga Heights: ground round the west wing 127.2..131.4 m, east wing 127.4..131.7 m, link 127.3..131.5 m, dining hall 127.2..131.2 m (low to the west and north). District Energy Plant: ground round the plant 125.4..126.6 m; cooling towers 124.1..126.3 m and 125.4..126.3 m. Field House: ground round it 115.1..118.5 m. Not modelled: the brick enclosure east of the Energy Plant (about (-9..5, 486..512)) and the walled enclosure near (-6, 682) are open-topped screen walls 2-4 m high in the 2017 LiDAR, not roofed buildings; the lattice structures near (96, 510), (101, 487) and (270, 582) are transmission towers (up to 54 m), not sheds; the teal object near (122, 540) is too small to tell (container or dumpster).
